source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 3 (PDF 54-74), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Circular and Rotational Motion) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define angular displacement and the radian. Show that S = rθ and that one revolution is 2π rad. Also define average and instantaneous angular velocity and give its unit and direction. (5 marks)
(Angular displacement aur radian ki definition likhein. Sabit karein ke S = rθ aur aik revolution 2π rad hai. Average aur instantaneous angular velocity ki definition, unit aur simt bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Soorat-e-haal: m mass ka particle P, r radius ke circle par be-wazn rigid rod OP ke sire par chalta hai jo markaz O par pivot hai (Fig. 3.2). Axis of rotation O se guzarta hai aur ghoomne ke plane par amoodi hai (z-axis); x aur y plane mein hain.

Angular displacement: waqt t par OP, OP₁ par hai aur x-axis se θ banata hai; t + Δt par OP₂ par θ + Δθ banata hai. Angle Δθ waqfe Δt mein OP ka angular displacement hai. Counter clockwise ke liye positive. Bohat chhote Δθ ke liye yeh axis ke saath vector hai, right hand rule se: axis ko daayen haath mein pakar kar ungliyan ghoomne ke rukh mein mudein; angootha angular displacement ki simt batata hai.

Radian: agar arc AB radius r ke barabar ho to markaz par angle aik radian (rad) hai, jo angle ki SI unit hai.
S lambai ka arc markaz par θ banaye (Fig. 3.3) to:
θ = S/r, ya S = rθ (θ radian mein) ... (3.1)

Aik revolution: aik chakkar mein P, S = 2πr tay karta hai:
θ = 2πr/r = 2π
1 revolution = 2π rad = 360°, aur 1 rad = 57.3°

Angular velocity: angular displacement ke waqt ke saath badalne ki sharah.
Average: ω_av = Δθ/Δt ... (3.2)
Instantaneous: ω = lim (Δt → 0) Δθ/Δt ... (3.3)
Is limit mein Δθ bohat chhota aur vector hai, is liye ω bhi vector hai, right hand rule se axis ke saath.
Unit: rad s⁻¹ (SI); rpm bhi.

book_ref.quote: Consider the motion of a single particle P of mass m in a circular path of radius r.

blocks.prompt:
2 A wheel turns uniformly at 450 rpm. Find (i) its angular velocity in rad s⁻¹ (ii) the angle it turns through in 2.0 s, in radians and revolutions (iii) the arc length covered in this time by a point 0.25 m from the axis. (3 marks)
(Aik pahiya yaksaan 450 rpm par ghoomta hai. Nikalein (i) angular velocity rad s⁻¹ mein (ii) 2.0 s mein ghooma hua angle, radian aur revolutions mein (iii) is waqt mein axis se 0.25 m door point ka tay kiya hua arc.)
blocks.explanation: rpm ko rev s⁻¹ aur phir rad s⁻¹ mein badlein; yaksaan rotation mein θ = ωt; S = rθ (θ radian mein).

book_ref.quote: Angular velocity is measured in radians per second which is the SI unit.

steps: Revolutions mein: 94.2/2π = 15 rev (7.5 rev s⁻¹ × 2.0 s = 15 rev)
blocks.final_answer: ω = 47.1 rad s⁻¹; θ = 94.2 rad = 15 rev; S = 23.6 m

blocks.prompt:
3 Define average and instantaneous angular acceleration and give their unit and direction. Explain how the rotation of a rigid body is described by its reference line, and write the equations of angular motion with their linear counterparts, stating when they hold. (5 marks)
(Average aur instantaneous angular acceleration ki definition, unit aur simt likhein. Wazeh karein ke rigid body ki rotation reference line se kaise bayan hoti hai, aur angular motion ki equations un ke linear jor ke saath likh kar batayein ke yeh kab sahi hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Angular acceleration: angular velocity ki tabdeeli ki sharah (maslan abhi on kiya gaya pankha). Agar tᵢ par ωᵢ aur t_f par ω_f ho:
α_av = (ω_f − ωᵢ)/(t_f − tᵢ) = Δω/Δt ... (3.4)
Instantaneous: α = lim (Δt → 0) Δω/Δt ... (3.5)
Yeh axis of rotation ke saath vector hai; unit rad s⁻².

Reference line: rigid body (Fig. 3.4) ke point P se axis par amood OP reference line hai. Jism ke saath OP usi angular velocity aur angular acceleration se ghoomti hai, is liye rigid body ki rotation OP ki rotation se bayan hoti hai.

Angular motion ki equations: Eqs. 3.2-3.5 linear equations jaisi hain, bas S, v, a ki jagah θ, ω, α. Is liye:
Linear: vf = vi + at → Angular: ωf = ωi + αt ... (3.9)
Linear: 2aS = vf² − vi² → Angular: 2αθ = ωf² − ωi² ... (3.10)
Linear: S = vit + ½at² → Angular: θ = ωit + ½αt² ... (3.11)

Shart: yeh sirf tab sahi hain jab axis fixed ho, taake sab angular vectors ki simt aik ho aur unhein scalars ki tarah liya ja sake.

book_ref.quote: As the other equations of linear motion were obtained by algebraic manipulation of these equations

blocks.prompt:
4 A ceiling fan is switched on and its angular velocity rises uniformly from zero to 4.0 rev s⁻¹ in 8.0 s. Find its angular acceleration (in rev s⁻² and rad s⁻²) and the number of revolutions it makes in this time. (3 marks)
(Pankha on karne par us ki angular velocity 8.0 s mein yaksaan tor par sifr se 4.0 rev s⁻¹ ho jati hai. Angular acceleration (rev s⁻² aur rad s⁻² mein) aur is dauran chakkaron ki tadaad nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: α ke liye ωf = ωi + αt, phir θ = ωit + ½αt²; 2αθ = ωf² − ωi² se check karein.

book_ref.quote: When we switch on an electric fan, we notice that its angular velocity goes on increasing.

steps: ωi = 0, ωf = 4.0 rev s⁻¹, t = 8.0 s
blocks.final_answer: α = 0.50 rev s⁻² = 3.14 rad s⁻²; 16 chakkar

blocks.prompt:
5 Derive the relation between the linear (tangential) velocity of a point of a rotating rigid body and the angular velocity. Why is this velocity called tangential? Also write the relation between tangential and angular acceleration and explain what these relations show. (5 marks)
(Ghoomte rigid body ke point ki linear (tangential) velocity aur angular velocity ka ta'alluq derive karein. Is velocity ko tangential kyun kehte hain? Tangential aur angular acceleration ka ta'alluq likh kar batayein ke yeh ta'alluqat kya dikhate hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Rigid body z-axis par ω se ghoomta hai (Fig. 3.5 a). Point P axis se r amoodi faasle par hai; OP reference line hai. P, r radius ke circle par v se chalta hai jab ke OP ω se ghoomti hai. Axis fixed hai, is liye ω ko scalar lete hain, aur v ki sirf magnitude.

Waqt Δt mein P arc P₁P₂ = ΔS tay karta hai aur OP Δθ radian ghoomti hai (Fig. 3.5 b). Eq. 3.1 se:
ΔS = r Δθ
Δt se taqseem karne par:
ΔS/Δt = r Δθ/Δt ... (3.6)
Δt → 0 par ΔS/Δt, P ki speed v aur Δθ/Δt, OP ki angular velocity ω hai:
v = rω ... (3.7)

Tangential velocity: Δt → 0 par arc P₁P₂ bohat chhota ho kar P₁ par tangent ke rukh hota hai. Is liye P ki velocity hamesha tangent ke saath hai; ise tangential velocity kehte hain.

Accelerations: agar OP ki angular acceleration α ho to P ki tangential acceleration aₜ; Eq. 3.7 se:
aₜ = rα ... (3.8)

Matlab: axis se mukhtalif faasle wale points ki speed aur acceleration mukhtalif hai, lekin fixed axis par ghoomte rigid body ke sab points ka angular displacement, angular speed aur angular acceleration har lamhe aik jaisa hai. Is liye angular variables poore jism ki harkat aasani se bayan karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Suppose during the course of its motion, the point P moves through a distance P₁P₂ = ΔS

blocks.prompt:
6 The angular velocity of a disc of radius 0.20 m increases uniformly from 10 rad s⁻¹ to 30 rad s⁻¹ in 4.0 s. Find (i) its angular acceleration (ii) the tangential acceleration of a point on the rim (iii) the linear speed of that point at the start and at the end. (3 marks)
(0.20 m radius wali disc ki angular velocity 4.0 s mein yaksaan tor par 10 rad s⁻¹ se 30 rad s⁻¹ ho jati hai. Nikalein (i) angular acceleration (ii) kinare ke point ki tangential acceleration (iii) us point ki linear speed shuru aur aakhir mein.)
blocks.explanation: ω ki tabdeeli se α, phir aₜ = rα aur v = rω.

book_ref.quote: Using Eq. 3.7 it can be shown that the two accelerations are related by

blocks.final_answer: α = 5.0 rad s⁻²; aₜ = 1.0 m s⁻²; speed 2.0 m s⁻¹ → 6.0 m s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
7 What is centripetal force? Explain why a body moving in a circle with uniform speed needs it, give its direction and expression, and name the agencies that provide it in different motions. (5 marks)
(Centripetal force kya hai? Wazeh karein ke yaksaan speed se circle mein chalne wale jism ko is ki zaroorat kyun hai, is ki simt aur formula likhein, aur mukhtalif harkaton mein ise faraham karne wale zaraye batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Force aur velocity: Newton ke doosre qanoon se force apni simt mein acceleration deti hai. Velocity ke rukh mein force sirf speed badalti hai. Circle mein chalte jism ki velocity par amoodi constant force sirf simt badalti hai; speed wohi rehti hai.

Zaroorat: dhaage se ufuqi circle mein ghoomti gend (Fig. 3.6 a) dhaaga tootne par circle mein nahi chalegi; A par seedhi line AB, yani A par tangent ke saath chalegi (Fig. 3.6 b). Is liye har point par simt musalsal badalne ke liye force chahiye.

Definition: particle ke seedhe raaste ko gol raaste mein morne wali force centripetal (markaz-joo) force kehlati hai.

Simt: yeh speed nahi badalti, sirf simt; radius ke saath hamesha markaz ki taraf, har point par tangential velocity par amoodi.

Formula: m mass, v speed, r radius:
F꜀ = ma꜀ = mv²/r ... (3.12)
jahan a꜀ = v²/r markaz ki taraf centripetal acceleration hai. v = rω se:
F꜀ = mrω² ... (3.13)

Zaraye:
1. Dhaage se ghoomti gend: dhaage ka tension.
2. Turntable par cheez: friction.
3. Zameen Sooraj ke gird, Chaand aur satellites Zameen ke gird: gravitational force.
4. Charged particle: amoodi magnetic force.
5. Mor par gaari: tyres aur sarak ki friction; phisalwaan sarak aur tez raftaar par yeh kaafi nahi, is liye sarak banked hoti hai (bahar ka kinara thora ooncha).

book_ref.quote: Newton's second law of motion states that when a force acts on a body, it produces acceleration in the same direction.

blocks.prompt:
8 A coin of mass 20 g lies 10 cm from the centre of a turntable that turns at 60 rpm. Find the angular velocity, the centripetal acceleration of the coin and the friction force needed to keep it in place. (3 marks)
(20 g ka sikka 60 rpm par ghoomte turntable ke markaz se 10 cm door rakha hai. Angular velocity, sikke ki centripetal acceleration aur use jagah par rakhne ke liye zaroori friction nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Friction hi centripetal force hai; rpm se ω, phir a꜀ = rω² aur F꜀ = ma꜀.

book_ref.quote: For an object placed on a turntable, the friction is the centripetal force.

steps: Yeh force sikke aur turntable ki friction deti hai.
blocks.final_answer: ω = 6.28 rad s⁻¹; a꜀ = 3.95 m s⁻²; friction = 0.079 N

blocks.prompt:
9 A ball tied to a string is whirled in a vertical circle of radius r. Find the tension in the string at the highest point when the speed there is v. What is the condition for the tension to be zero there? Use the result to explain why water does not fall from a bucket whirled rapidly in a vertical circle. (5 marks)
(Dhaage se bandhi gend r radius ke vertical circle mein ghumayi jati hai. Sab se oopar wale point par speed v ho to dhaage ka tension nikalein. Wahan tension sifr hone ki shart kya hai? Is nateeje se wazeh karein ke vertical circle mein tezi se ghumayi gayi baalti se paani kyun nahi girta.)
blocks.explanation:
Soorat-e-haal: m mass ki gend dhaage se gravity ke tehat r radius ke vertical circle mein chalti hai (Fig. 3.7). Sab se oopar point A par speed v hai.

A par forces: do forces, dhaage ka khinchao T aur wazan w = mg. Dono A par radius ke saath markaz O ki taraf hain. Gend circle mein chale, is liye in ka vector jama zaroori centripetal force ke barabar ho:
T + w = mv²/r
w = mg se:
T = mv²/r − mg = m(v²/r − g)

Sifr tension: agar v²/r = g ho to T = 0 aur centripetal force bilkul wazan ke barabar hai. Is ke liye oopar speed v = √(gr).

Paani ki baalti: oopar paani ko bhi markaz ki taraf mv²/r chahiye. Tez ghumane par mv²/r wazan mg se kam nahi hota; wazan aur baalti ke tale ka dhakka mil kar sirf paani ko circle par rakhne mein kharch hote hain. Is liye paani baalti se laga rehta hai aur ulti baalti se bhi nahi girta.

book_ref.quote: For the ball to travel in a circle, the force acting on the ball must provide the required centripetal force.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Example 3.3 ka nateeja T = m(v²/r − g) hai. Baalti mein dhaage ke tension ki jagah baalti ka tala paani ko dhakelta hai. Jab tak v²/r ≥ g hai, paani ko circle par rakhne ke liye wazan kaafi nahi, tala bhi dhakelta hai, is liye paani tale se juda nahi hota.

blocks.prompt:
10 A 0.20 kg ball on a string 0.80 m long is whirled in a vertical circle. Find the tension in the string at the highest point when the ball's speed there is 4.0 m s⁻¹. What is the least speed at the top for which the string stays just taut? (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) (3 marks)
(0.20 kg ki gend 0.80 m lambe dhaage se vertical circle mein ghumayi jati hai. Sab se oopar speed 4.0 m s⁻¹ ho to dhaage ka tension nikalein. Oopar kam az kam kitni speed par dhaaga bas tana rehta hai? (g = 9.8 m s⁻²))
blocks.explanation: Oopar T + mg = mv²/r, yani T = m(v²/r − g); T = 0 par dhaaga dheela, yani v = √(gr).

book_ref.quote: If v²/r = g, then T will be zero and the centripetal force is just equal to the weight.

steps: Kam az kam speed: T = 0 jab v²/r = g
blocks.final_answer: T = 2.04 N ≈ 2.0 N; oopar kam az kam speed = 2.8 m s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
11 What are artificial satellites? Derive the critical velocity of a satellite orbiting close to the Earth and the period of its revolution. How do the speed and period change for a satellite much higher above the Earth? (5 marks)
(Masnooi satellites kya hain? Zameen ke qareeb ghoomne wale satellite ki critical velocity aur chakkar ka period derive karein. Zameen se kahin zyada oonchai wale satellite ki speed aur period kaise badalte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Masnooi satellites: woh cheezen jo Zameen ke gird taqreeban gol raaste par ghoomti hain. Rockets unhein orbit mein dalte hain aur Zameen ki gravity unhein wahan rakhti hai. Gravity na ho to woh orbit ke tangent ke saath nikal jayen. (Newton ki pesh goi: kaafi oonchi jagah se khaas speed par ufuqi phenki cheez Zameen ke gird ghoomne lagegi.)

Critical velocity: neeche urne wale satellite ki acceleration Zameen ke markaz ki taraf g = 9.8 m s⁻² hai. Circle mein us ki acceleration v²/r hai. Gol orbit mein gravity centripetal acceleration deti hai:
g = v²/R ... (3.14)
jahan R Zameen ka radius (6400 km) hai. Is liye
v = √(gR) = √(9.8 × 6.4 × 10⁶) = 7.9 × 10³ m s⁻¹ = 7.9 km s⁻¹
Yeh satellite ko orbit mein dalne ki kam az kam velocity, yani critical velocity hai.

Period:
T = 2πR/v = 2 × 3.14 × 6400 km / 7.9 km s⁻¹ ≈ 5060 s, taqreeban 84 min.

Oonche satellites: R se kahin zyada oonchai h par gravitational acceleration Zameen ke markaz se faasle ke murabba ke ulat kam hoti hai. Satellite jitna ooncha, utni kam speed chahiye aur aik chakkar mein utna zyada waqt.

book_ref.quote: Satellites are objects that orbit in nearly circular path around the Earth.

blocks.prompt:
12 A satellite moves in a circular orbit of radius 6.8 × 10⁶ m, where the gravitational acceleration is 8.7 m s⁻². Find its orbital speed and its period in minutes. (3 marks)
(Satellite 6.8 × 10⁶ m radius ke gol orbit mein hai jahan gravitational acceleration 8.7 m s⁻² hai. Us ki orbital speed aur period minutes mein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Orbit par gravity centripetal acceleration deti hai: g = v²/r se v; phir T = 2πr/v.

book_ref.quote: When the satellite is moving in a circle, it has an acceleration v²/r.

steps: T = 5555/60 = 92.6 min (Zameen ke qareeb wale ke taqreeban 85 min se zyada)

blocks.prompt:
13 Derive an expression for the orbital speed of a satellite revolving around the Earth in a circular orbit of radius r. Show that it does not depend on the satellite's mass, and explain what happens if the satellite's speed is less than this value. How is the period found? (5 marks)
(Zameen ke gird r radius ke gol orbit mein ghoomte satellite ki orbital speed ka formula derive karein. Sabit karein ke yeh satellite ke mass par munhasir nahi, aur batayein ke is se kam speed par kya hota hai. Period kaise nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Maan lein mₛ mass ka satellite M mass wali Zameen ke gird r radius ke gol orbit mein v speed se chalta hai (Fig. 3.12).

Zaroori centripetal force: mₛv²/r.
Yeh force Zameen aur satellite ke darmiyan gravitational kashish GmₛM/r² deti hai. Barabar karne par:
GmₛM/r² = mₛv²/r
mₛ aur aik r kaatne par:
v² = GM/r
v = √(GM/r) ... (3.15)

Satellite ka mass: mₛ kat jata hai, is liye orbit bayan karne mein satellite ka mass ghair ahem hai. Zameen ke markaz se r faasle par har satellite ki speed Eq. 3.15 wali hogi.

Kam speed: is se kam speed satellite ko wapas Zameen par gira degi.

Period: aik chakkar mein satellite 2πr tay karta hai, is liye T = 2πr/v, jahan satah se h oonchai par r = R + h (Example 3.4).

book_ref.quote: Figure 3.12 shows a satellite going round the Earth in a circular path.

blocks.prompt:
14 A satellite revolves in a circular orbit 1600 km above the Earth's surface. Find its orbital speed and period. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻², M = 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg, R = 6400 km) (3 marks)
(Satellite Zameen ki satah se 1600 km oopar gol orbit mein ghoomta hai. Us ki orbital speed aur period nikalein. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻², M = 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg, R = 6400 km))
blocks.explanation: Orbit ka radius markaz se naapein (r = R + h), v = √(GM/r), phir T = 2πr/v.

book_ref.quote: Take mass of the Earth M = 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg and its radius R = 6400 km.

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain why bodies and astronauts inside an orbiting satellite experience weightlessness. Show mathematically that the supporting force on a body inside the satellite is zero. (5 marks)
(Wazeh karein ke ghoomte satellite ke andar ajsaam aur astronauts be-wazni kyun mehsoos karte hain. Riyazi tor par sabit karein ke satellite ke andar jism par sahara dene wali force sifr hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Wajah: ghoomte satellite ke andar har cheez be-wazni mehsoos karti hai kyunke satellite azad girte jism ki tarah Zameen ke markaz ki taraf accelerate karta hai.

Saboot: r radius ke orbit mein M mass ka satellite lein. m mass ka jism chhat se spring balance par latka hai (Fig. 3.13). Do forces: wazan mg neeche (Zameen ki taraf) aur sahara dene wali force F_N (spring ka tension) oopar. In ka hasil m ke liye Zameen ke markaz ki taraf zaroori centripetal force hai:
F꜀ = mg − F_N ... (3.16)
F꜀ = mv²/r se:
mv²/r = mg − F_N ... (3.16-a)

Satellite ki apni centripetal force gravity deti hai:
F_g = F꜀, yani Mg = Mv²/r, is liye g = v²/r
Eq. 3.16-a mein v²/r = g rakhne se:
mg = mg − F_N, yani F_N = 0

Nateeja: satellite ke andar jism par sahara dene wali force sifr hai, spring balance sifr dikhata hai. Is liye ajsaam aur astronauts zahiri be-wazni (apparent weightlessness) mein hote hain; gravity ab bhi lagti hai aur centripetal force deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Consider a satellite of mass M revolving in its orbit of radius r around the Earth.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan M satellite ka mass hai (pichhle topic mein M Zameen ka mass tha). Asal baat: satellite aur andar ki cheez dono ki acceleration v²/r = g hai, is liye spring ko kuch kheenchna nahi parta.

blocks.prompt:
16 A satellite moves in a circular orbit of radius 7.0 × 10⁶ m where the gravitational acceleration is 8.2 m s⁻². A 2.0 kg mass hangs from a spring balance inside it. Find (i) the speed of the satellite (ii) the centripetal force needed by the mass and its weight there (iii) the reading of the balance. (3 marks)
(Satellite 7.0 × 10⁶ m radius ke gol orbit mein hai jahan gravitational acceleration 8.2 m s⁻² hai. Andar 2.0 kg mass spring balance se latka hai. Nikalein (i) satellite ki speed (ii) mass ki zaroori centripetal force aur wahan us ka wazan (iii) balance ki reading.)
blocks.explanation: Gravity satellite ki centripetal acceleration deti hai (g = v²/r); phir latke mass ke liye mv²/r = mg − F_N.

book_ref.quote: Their resultant force is equal to the centripetal force required by the mass m

blocks.final_answer: v = 7.58 km s⁻¹; dono forces 16.4 N; balance sifr dikhata hai

blocks.prompt:
17 What is artificial gravity and why is it needed in a spaceship? Derive the frequency with which a spaceship of outer radius R must rotate to provide gravity like that of the Earth. (5 marks)
(Artificial gravity kya hai aur spaceship mein is ki zaroorat kyun hai? R bairooni radius wale spaceship ko Zameen jaisi gravity dene ke liye ghoomne ki frequency derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Zaroorat: gravity se khaali khala mein koi force kisi ko spacecraft ki kisi taraf nahi dhakelti. Lambe arse tak be-wazni astronauts ki karkardagi mutassir kar sakti hai. Artificial gravity se crew taqreeban aam tareeqe se kaam kar sakta hai.

Tareeqa: spaceship ko apne axis par ghumaya jata hai. Astronaut bahar ke kinare ki taraf dabta hai aur Zameen ki tarah 'farsh' par force lagata hai; ghoomte jahaz ki satah use dhakel kar centripetal force deti hai.

Derivation: bairooni radius R aur angular speed ω (Fig. 3.14). Bahar ke kinare ke point ki centripetal acceleration
a꜀ = Rω²
(book correction: yeh centripetal acceleration hai, angular nahi).
ω = 2π/t, jahan t chakkar ka period hai:
a꜀ = R 4π²/t²
f = 1/t se:
a꜀ = R 4π² f²
f² = a꜀/(4π²R), ya f = (1/2π)√(a꜀/R)
Zameen jaisi gravity ke liye a꜀ = g:
f = (1/2π)√(g/R) ... (3.17)

Is frequency par ghoomne se rehne walon ko Zameen jaisi artificial gravity milti hai.

book_ref.quote: In a gravity free space, there will be no force that will push anybody to any side of the spacecraft.

blocks.prompt:
18 A wheel-shaped spaceship has an outer radius of 150 m. Find the frequency, period and angular speed with which it must rotate to give Earth-like gravity (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) at its rim. What is the speed of a point on the rim? (3 marks)
(Pahiye jaise spaceship ka bairooni radius 150 m hai. Kinare par Zameen jaisi gravity (g = 9.8 m s⁻²) ke liye ghoomne ki frequency, period aur angular speed nikalein. Kinare ke point ki speed kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: f = (1/2π)√(g/R); phir t = 1/f, ω = 2πf aur v = Rω.

book_ref.quote: The outer radius of the spaceship is R and it rotates around its own central axis with angular speed

blocks.prompt:
19 Define moment of inertia. Starting from F = ma for a single mass on a massless rod, show that τ = Iα, and extend the result to a rigid body to obtain I = Σmᵢrᵢ². (5 marks)
(Moment of inertia ki definition likhein. Be-wazn rod par aik mass ke liye F = ma se shuru kar ke τ = Iα sabit karein, aur nateeje ko rigid body tak barha kar I = Σmᵢrᵢ² hasil karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aik mass: m mass be-wazn rod ke sire par hai jo O par be-ragar bearing par pivot hai, ufuqi plane mein (Fig. 3.15). Rod par amoodi force F mass par lagti hai:
F = ma
Mass O ke gird ghoomta hai; tangential acceleration a_T = rα, is liye
F = mrα
Ghumane ka asar torque se hota hai, is liye dono taraf r se zarb dein:
rF = τ = mr²α
Yeh F = ma ka rotational mutabadil hai: F ki jagah τ, a ki jagah α aur m ki jagah mr².

Moment of inertia: mr² moment of inertia I hai. Angular motion mein yeh wohi kirdar ada karta hai jo linear motion mein mass, aur sirf m par nahi r² par bhi munhasir hai.

Rigid body: jism chhote masses m₁, m₂, ..., mₙ se bana hai jo axis se r₁, r₂, ..., rₙ par hain (Fig. 3.16). Torques:
τ₁ = m₁r₁²α, τ₂ = m₂r₂²α, waghaira
(jism rigid hai, sab ka α aik). Kul torque:
τ_total = (Σmᵢrᵢ²)α
τ = Iα ... (3.18)
jahan I = Σmᵢrᵢ² ... (3.19) jism ka moment of inertia hai (unit kg m²).

21 Define angular momentum of a particle and give its magnitude, direction and SI unit. Show that for a particle in a circle L = mr²ω, and that for a symmetric rigid body rotating about a fixed axis L = Iω. (5 marks)
(Particle ke angular momentum ki definition, magnitude, simt aur SI unit likhein. Sabit karein ke circle mein particle ke liye L = mr²ω aur fixed axis par ghoomte symmetric rigid body ke liye L = Iω.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: particle kisi reference axis ke gird angular momentum rakhta hai agar us ki angular position us axis ke lehaaz se badle. m mass, v velocity aur p momentum wale particle ke liye origin O ke gird:
L = r × p ... (3.20)
jahan r, O ke lehaaz se position vector hai.

Magnitude: L = rp sin θ = mrv sin θ, θ r aur p ke darmiyan angle.
Simt: r aur p ke plane par amoodi, vector product ke right hand rule se.
SI unit: kg m² s⁻¹ ya J s.

Circle mein particle: r radius ke circle mein yaksaan ω par r aur tangential velocity 90° par hain:
L = mrv sin 90° = mrv
v = rω se L = mr²ω

Rigid body: symmetric rigid body centre of mass se guzarte fixed axis par ghoomta hai (Fig. 3.17). Har particle usi ω se circle mein chalta hai. i-th particle ka Lᵢ = mᵢvᵢrᵢ, ω ki simt mein; vᵢ = rᵢω se Lᵢ = mᵢrᵢ²ω. Sab ko jama karne se:
L = (Σmᵢrᵢ²)ω = Iω
jahan I axis ke gird jism ka moment of inertia hai.

23 State the law of conservation of angular momentum and show that I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂ for a spinning body that changes its moment of inertia. Explain with three examples, and explain why the axis of rotation keeps a fixed direction. (5 marks)
(Angular momentum ke tahaffuz ka qanoon bayan karein aur moment of inertia badalne wale ghoomte jism ke liye I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂ dikhayein. Teen misalon se wazeh karein, aur batayein ke axis of rotation apni simt kyun qaim rakhta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Qanoon: agar system par koi bairooni torque na lage to us ka kul angular momentum constant rehta hai:
L_total = L₁ + L₂ + ... = constant
Yeh bunyadi usool hai, kainaati sateh se khurdbeeni se chhoti sateh tak sabit.

Moment of inertia ki tabdeeli: I₁ moment of inertia aur ω₁ se ghoomta jism apna moment of inertia I₂ kar leta hai; bairooni torque nahi, is liye L = Iω constant aur ω badal kar ω₂:
I₁ω₁ = I₂ω₂
I kam ho to ω barhti hai, I barhe to ω kam hoti hai.

Misalein:
1. Diver: springboard chhor kar baazu aur taangein samet leta hai, I kam aur ω zyada; paani se pehle phaila deta hai, ω kam aur narmi se paani mein.
2. Ice skater: baazu samet kar aur taang andar la kar I kam, ω zyada; phailane se I zyada, ω kam.
3. Turntable par dumb-bells wala aadmi: haath andar karne se I kam, angular speed foran zyada.
(Mazeed: qutbi barf pighal kar beh jaye to Zameen ka I barhta hai, ω kam hoti hai aur din lamba hota hai.)

Fixed axis: angular momentum axis ke saath vector hai, is liye us ki simt bhi qaim rehti hai. Bairooni torque ke baghair axis rukh nahi badalta. Zameen par bari force Sooraj ki kashish hai jo qabil-e-zikr torque nahi deti, is liye Zameen ka axis aik simt mein qaim hai.
